verdict.rationale: The SDK is driven by natural-language prompts: `query(prompt="Hello Claude")` starts an agent loop that evaluates the prompt, calls tools and repeats until done. ClaudeSDKClient and streaming input mode support long-lived, interactive chat sessions that take user input and clarifying questions, and skills can be invoked with `/skill-name`. The bundled Claude Code CLI also accepts natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural language must be wrapped in Python/TypeScript code rather than used as a standalone interface, and there is no independent hands-on evidence of how well natural-language commands are interpreted.
